title: Concept: Risky container build or runtime setting (user) — review required
description: For user, USERs+rootb weakens container isolation or build integrity. Containers share the host kernel, so each relaxation moves toward host equivalence. The remedy is a non-root USER.
applicability: Containerfiles and compose files; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Breakout, secret theft, or poisoned builds; MEDIUM severity, HIGH for privileged/host modes.
